name: Illiyana Moonblaze
summary: Illiyana Moonblaze is a night elf supply officer stationed at Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. Operating alongside the Silverwing Sentinels, she supplies Alliance champions waging war against the Warsong Outriders.

sections.title: Silverwing Supply Officer
sections.body: Illiyana Moonblaze serves as the supply officer for the Silverwing Sentinels nestled in Silverwing Grove. From her post near the path into Warsong Gulch, she outfits the defenders who hold the southern woods of Ashenvale against the Warsong clan.

sections.title: Supplies for the Front Lines
sections.body: Beyond keeping the grove's stores, Illiyana equips Alliance volunteers preparing to clash with the Warsong clan in Warsong Gulch. As champions earn favor with the Silverwing Sentinels, she rewards their service with custom rations, specialized draughts, and masterwork armaments designed specifically for woodland skirmishes. She also maintains weapons and armor for weary fighters returning from the frontline, keeping the Sentinels' war effort supplied and functional.

faq.q: Where can I find Illiyana Moonblaze?
faq.answer: She is located at Silverwing Grove in southeastern Ashenvale, near the staging grounds and portal leading into Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: Is Illiyana Moonblaze a member of the Sentinels?
faq.answer: She serves as the Silverwing Supply Officer, working alongside the Silverwing Sentinels to outfit and supply the Alliance champions who fight beside them.

faq.q: What does Illiyana offer to Alliance champions?
faq.answer: She acts as the Silverwing Sentinels' quartermaster, offering care packages, battlefield armaments, rings, tabards, and consumables tailored for the struggle in Warsong Gulch to those who gain reputation with the faction.
Yes, alongside supplying specialized military gear, she offers standard weapon and armor repair services to Alliance defenders resting at the grove.

faq.q: What care packages does she hand out?
faq.answer: She assists Alliance fighters through logistical quests involving Sentinel Basic, Standard, and Advanced Care Packages, supplying frontline defenders with essential battlefield provisions.

angles.text: For Alliance fighters marching south into the contested border of Warsong Gulch, Illiyana is the primary quartermaster supplying weapons, armor, and rations.
Illiyana keeps the Silverwing Sentinels supplied, showing how the kaldorei rally every hand to safeguard Ashenvale.
